title: Law to require ads to disclose unregistered e-bike lookalikes
summary: This bill would ban advertising mopeds, motorcycles or unregistered scooters as if they were legal powered bicycles or mobility devices. Ads for vehicles that must be registered with the state Department of Motor Vehicles would have to clearly say so. The city's Department of Consumer and Worker Protection would also have to create outreach materials explaining which devices are legal to ride on city streets, with the law taking effect 180 days after enactment.
